summary: Elevate your career with our Professional Certificate in Leadership & Communication training. Gain essential skills to lead effectively.
lede: A Professional Certificate in Leadership & Communication helps you lead people, influence outcomes, and communicate with clarity, confidence, and credibility. It addresses the leadership and communication barriers behind many workplace challenges, from unclear priorities to difficult conversations and stakeholder uncertainty. Through practical, hands-on training, you will build skills for leading with purpose, influencing without authority, and communicating effectively in meetings, reports, projects, and senior leadership interactions. The course provides actionable tools to improve workplace performance across functions, cultures, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals at various leadership stages.
audience: Sales, client service, and account managers
modules: Day 1: The Psychological Drivers of Leadership
Understanding the psychology of workplace behavior
Day 2: Developing High Performance Team Culture
Active listening for efficient working relationships
Delegation and accountability for higher performance
Developing and improving your Interpersonal skills
Day 3: Stakeholder Management and Political Intelligence
Effective techniques to communicate vision and strategy
Effective writing to achieve simplicity of expression, accuracy of content and brevity of style
Understand the importance of data presentation in conveying complex information.
Understand the importance of effective crisis communication in managing emergencies and preserving trust.
Day 5: Presentation Skills and the Art of Rhetoric
Understand the concept of executive presence and its importance in leadership and communication.
Psychological factor: Controlling nerves and stress management
Understand the key elements of compelling presentations and effective public speaking.
Understand the principles of effective storytelling and its importance in communication and influence.
prerequisites: This program is from Harvard’s Office of the Vice Provost for Advances in Learning (VPAL), in association with HarvardX. It is offered in collaboration with GetSmarter, an edX partner. Learners will receive a LEORON certificate of attendance upon the completion of the Face 2 Face Onsite training provided and delivered by LEORON Institute.
